items.title: Local History: Nathan Bedford Forrest, ‘Wizard of the Saddle’
items.summary: Nathan Bedford Forrest, one of the most polarizing figures of the Civil War era, was born July 1821 in Chapel Hill, Tennessee, a small town on the Duck River.
